user.title: Choose your switch or remote
user.description:
Select the physical device already added to Home Assistant. We will find its button inputs, supported gestures and supported status indicators. Protocol setup and device firmware stay in the device’s own integration.

{hint}

review.title: Review your control

leds.title: Custom LED mappings (advanced)
leds.description: Optional override for LED controls not covered by automatic discovery. Enter a JSON list of LED channels, or [] to remove this override and use automatic discovery. Only select and number configuration entities are accepted. Copy exact options or values from your device; light and switch loads cannot be used. Keep LED and button IDs stable. {error}

review_leds.title: Review your control

error.no_supported_inputs: This device does not expose supported button events or device triggers. Enable its button/event entities in its own integration, check the device firmware or scene settings, then try again. A light or switch load alone cannot supply gestures.
error.device_unavailable: The device is no longer available. Go back and choose an available device.
error.device_changed: The device inputs changed while this form was open. Review the current buttons and try again.
error.invalid_control: Choose each physical button at most once and enter a nonempty control name (at most 128 characters). Review the available inputs before saving.
error.invalid_led_mapping: Invalid LED mapping. Review the validation detail above and the LED setup documentation.
error.mqtt_not_configured: Add and configure the MQTT integration first, then save this control.
error.device_already_configured: This device already has a gesture control. Edit that control instead, or choose a different device.
error.unsupported_device_configuration: This device’s input setup is not currently supported. Review the detail above. Enable native button event entities if available, or adjust the device’s action discovery settings, then try again.

abort.device_already_configured: This device already has a gesture control. Edit that control instead, or choose a different device.
